newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber gets $250 mln credit commitment.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber gets $250 mln credit commitment.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc, which provides local telecommunications services, said Friday it received a commitment from Goldman Sachs Credit Partners LP to fully underwrite a $250 million senior secured credit facility.
Goldman, Sachs Credit will serve as syndication agent and Bank Boston will serve as administrative agent.
David Solomon, Brooks Fiber chief financial officer, said proceeds of the transaction will be used to fund the continued development of its business plan.

"Based upon current rates, terms of the facility would enable the company to borrow at or below eight percent, further reducing the company's overall borrowing costs to approximately 10 percent," he added. "This credit facility, in conjunction with a $250 million private placement of senior notes closed at the end of May, 1997, fully funds the company's known capital needs in our current 44 markets."
With networks operational or under construction in 44 U.S. cities, the company provides its customers with voice, video, data and other enhanced telecommunications services.
